newsitem.title: USA: Martin Marietta Materials names chairman.
newsitem.headline: Martin Marietta Materials names chairman.

text.p: Martin Marieta Materials Inc said Thursday its board has elected the company's chief executive and president, Stephen Zelnak Jr, as chairman, effective immediately.

Zelnak, who was vice chairman prior to the election, succeeds as chairman Marcus Bennett, executive vice president and chief financial officer of Lockheed Martin Corp, who has served in that capacity during Martin Marietta Materials' transition from Lockheed Martin ownership to its current status as a fully independent public company, it said.
Bennett will continue to serve as an outside board member of Martin Marietta Materials, the company said.

Zelnak had been serving as president and CEO of Martin Marietta Materials since its formation in 1993. He joined the company as a vice president in 1981, when it was a division Martin Marietta, the defense contractor that later merged with Lockheed.
The company, a producer of construction aggregates and magnesia-based chemical and refractory products, became public in February 1994, selling 19 percent of its stock.
In October 1996, Lockhed Martin sold its remaining 81 percent stake in the company through a split-off transaction with its shareholders.
